name: eu.cyprusjobs/jobs
title: CyprusJobs.eu — jobs in Cyprus
description: Jobs in Cyprus in English, Greek and Russian: vacancies, pay by job and town, take-home pay.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open vacancies in Cyprus on CyprusJobs.eu by words, town, field, minimum monthly pay, accommodation and language. Returns up to 20 vacancies with pay, town, employer and the link to apply. Applying is free; never pay anyone to get a job.

query.description: Words to look for in the job title or company, e.g. 'waiter', 'receptionist', 'accountant'

town.description: Town in Cyprus; leave out for the whole island

field.description: Field of work, e.g. hospitality, sales, IT

min_monthly_salary.description: Only vacancies paying at least this many euros gross a month

no_greek_needed.description: Only vacancies that ask for English and not Greek

no_experience.description: Only vacancies open to people without experience

language.description: Language of the links and labels: en, el (Greek) or ru (Russian)

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full details of one vacancy on CyprusJobs.eu: duties, requirements, pay, town, type of work, languages, accommodation and how to apply. Pass the vacancy id or its CyprusJobs.eu link.

job.description: Vacancy id or link, e.g. https://cyprusjobs.eu/jobs/waiter--abc123

language.description: Language of the links and labels: en, el (Greek) or ru (Russian); default en

tools.name: job_market_overview
tools.description: How many vacancies are open on CyprusJobs.eu now, by town and by field, how many arrived in the last 7 days, and typical monthly pay from vacancies that state it.

language.description: Language of the links and labels: en, el (Greek) or ru (Russian); default en

tools.name: net_salary_cyprus
tools.description: Take-home pay in Cyprus under the 2026 rules (social insurance 8.8%, GESY 2.65%, income tax bands from €22,000) for a gross monthly salary, with 12 or 13 salaries a year. An estimate for a tax-resident employee, not tax advice.

tools.name: salary_insights
tools.description: What open vacancies in Cyprus pay now, from CyprusJobs.eu vacancies that state monthly pay: median, low and high for a job title, field or town, split by town and by field, with the number of vacancies behind each figure. Needs an API key (free during our launch): https://cyprusjobs.eu/developers.

job_title.description: Words of the job title, e.g. 'waiter', 'accountant'

field.description: Field of work, to see pay across all its jobs

town.description: Town in Cyprus, to see pay there only

language.description: Language of the links and labels: en, el (Greek) or ru (Russian); default en

tools.name: vacancy_feed
tools.description: Full vacancies that employers posted on CyprusJobs.eu themselves (not copied from other sites), newest first, with description, pay, town and the link to apply; page through with offset. For job agents, aggregators and HR services that keep their own copy fresh. Needs an API key (free during our launch): https://cyprusjobs.eu/developers.

since.description: Only vacancies posted on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD

offset.description: How many vacancies to skip, for the next page (default 0)

language.description: Language of the links and labels: en, el (Greek) or ru (Russian); default en
